title: feat: functional phase 11 screen vision
body:
## Summary

Phase 11 replaces the metadata-only screen-vision checkpoint with a bounded, explicit Windows path: on-demand display enumeration, Owner-confirmed GDI capture of the selected monitor, transient in-memory pixels, a replaceable local visual adapter, and truthful unavailable/degraded behavior when no local model is installed. There is no continuous watcher, upload, public listener, or raw screenshot persistence.

## Implementation

- `9827ee4` adds bounded Windows display capture/provider plumbing and real-vs-fixture UI metadata.
- `2beca1f` adds deterministic/local adapter contracts, transient lifecycle cleanup, resource gating and degraded real-job behavior.
- `a2ee44b`, `7c120b7`, `f584259` align Windows-dependent and contract/UI tests with the real-display path.
- `4eed9f5` enumerates up to 16 monitors with selected bounds/origin and wires per-job in-memory cancellation through capture and adapter checkpoints.
- `6cb6a2e` aligns Rust/TypeScript to an 18-record bound (two fixtures + 16 displays).
- `f2b2f84` reconciles known-limitations documentation with the shipped API.

## Evidence

- Final HEAD: `f2b2f84c53ae1ef43e0075dd67bb132fa0cbcdd6`; remote branch was created from the Phase 10 parent `f2975033ae602c7ef14e1dbcc7d68694f8093ac0`, while PR base is merged `main` `ceccd4cbb897b935dbf9e956e2713fa0487ed6ae`.
- Rust host gates: fmt/check/clippy passed; `cargo test --locked --lib` passed `125`, failed `0`, with `1` optional test ignored; focused screen-vision tests passed (`6`).
- Contracts: typecheck/build/tests passed (`19`). Desktop: typecheck/tests/build passed (`49` tests; Vite production build passed). `pnpm secrets:scan` passed (`149` files). `git diff --check` passed.
- Distinct Biel4 read-only final review: `approved_with_reservations`, zero blocking findings; reservations are packaged/manual Windows behavior, local model installation, privacy/UX and visual-quality validation.
- Codex Security diff scan `b807de9e-cb82-4f59-80d4-76fb8d2e5267` for `ceccd4c..f2b2f84`: complete coverage, zero findings. TAC advisory connector was unavailable (`USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN`) and delegated security workers were unavailable, so parent coverage was used.

## Boundaries and status

This is `FUNCTIONAL — AUTOMATED CAPTURE/PROVIDER CHECKPOINT`; it is not stable-release approval. The local visual model intentionally degrades to unavailable until installed/configured. Packaged Windows/manual privacy and UX, real multi-monitor behavior under load, cancellation under load, visual quality, remote CI and Owner release approval remain pending. Phase 12 Android and Phase 13 gateway remain unchanged.
